none: PAS NLM-64BF42: Roman Nummus of Valentinian or Valens
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375) or Valens (364-378). Reece Period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding laburum. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIA[R]O[MANO]RVM Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.66mm, Weight: 2.39gms, die axis: 7
